cypher: MATCH (n:Service) WHERE (n.name = $t OR n.name = ('opentelemetry-' + $t) OR n.dir = $t) RETURN n.name
MATCH (n:File) WHERE (n.path = $t OR n.path ENDS WITH $t) RETURN n.path ORDER BY size(n.path) LIMIT 1

MATCH p=(x:File)-[:IMPORTS*1..3]->(t:File {path:$k}) RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | [labels(n)[0], coalesce(n.path,n.qname,n.sha,n.email,n.id,n.name), coalesce(n.msg,n.title,n.name,n.qname,n.path,n.email)]] AS ns, [r IN relationships(p) | type(r)] AS rs LIMIT 400
MATCH (s:Service)-[:CONTAINS]->(f:File {path:$k}) RETURN s.name

MATCH p=(x:Service)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..3]->(t:Service {name:$k}) RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | [labels(n)[0], coalesce(n.path,n.qname,n.sha,n.email,n.id,n.name), coalesce(n.msg,n.title,n.name,n.qname,n.path,n.email)]] AS ns, [r IN relationships(p) | type(r)] AS rs LIMIT 200

MATCH p=(c:Commit)-[m:MODIFIED]->(t:File) WHERE t.path IN $k AND c.ts >= $since RETURN c.sha, c.msg, c.ts, m.adds, m.dels, [n IN nodes(p) | [labels(n)[0], coalesce(n.path,n.qname,n.sha,n.email,n.id,n.name), coalesce(n.msg,n.title,n.name,n.qname,n.path,n.email)]] AS ns, [r IN relationships(p) | type(r)] AS rs

MATCH (o:File)-[:IMPORTS]->(d:File) WHERE o.path IN $k MATCH p=(c:Commit)-[m:MODIFIED]->(d) WHERE c.ts >= $since AND NOT d.path IN $k RETURN c.sha, c.msg, c.ts, m.adds, m.dels, [n IN nodes(p) | [labels(n)[0], coalesce(n.path,n.qname,n.sha,n.email,n.id,n.name), coalesce(n.msg,n.title,n.name,n.qname,n.path,n.email)]] AS ns, [r IN relationships(p) | type(r)] AS rs
